audit.whatIsWrong: Three sources give three different level charts and I could not reconcile them, so I left every side/win row untouched. Full and content already agree with each other (Vayne, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Vayne, Kayle, Kayle), so nothing is currently half-updated.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is Vayne x5 then Skill then Kayle, which matches Kayle being melee and rangeless until Divine Ascent gives her range at 6. The mirror audit (kayle__vayne) settled on Vayne, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Vayne, which puts Kayle ahead at levels 4-5 while she is still melee and gives Vayne the two-item row against a fully scaled ranged Kayle. Both cannot be right and guessing would ship a fabricated power shift. Escalated instead — see questionsForUser.
audit.corrected: No chart edit proposed. whys[2] and whys[3] still say 'favours you' while win[2]/win[3] say Kayle — that internal contradiction is real and gets fixed the moment the chart is settled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as 'her get-out at 6' with no cooldown anywhere; the packet flagged zero sequencing cues for this matchup.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80 — the longest ultimate cooldown in the lane by a wide margin. At rank 1 baiting it buys almost three minutes of free commitment, which is the single most actionable number in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Put 160s at rank 1 falling to 80s at rank 3 into spikes[1], mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentioned Celestial Blessing's sustain or Starfire Spellblade's auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing (W) is a flat 15s heal on herself and the nearest ally — it is what makes her survive the extended trades this matchup is built on, so Grievous Wounds timing decides them. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto reset on 8s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5, so her burst opens on the attack wind-up, not on a visible cast.
audit.corrected: Added both to early; the heal also drives the Executioner's Calling line already present in report[8].

edits.before: Kayle is the definition of a weak early lane: melee and rangeless until 6, with no CC and low defenses. Abuse every second: walk her down, stack Silver Bolts, and deny as much CS as you can because her whole game is scaling. Freeze low near your tower to make her farm miserable and open her to ganks. The harder you starve her now, the later her spike arrives.
edits.after: Kayle is the definition of a weak early lane: melee and rangeless until 6, with no CC and low defenses. Abuse every second: walk her down, stack Silver Bolts, deny CS. Her sustain is Celestial Blessing (W) on a flat 15s, so buy Executioner's Calling before you commit to long trades. Starfire Spellblade (E) is a 6-8s auto reset — the wind-up is your step-back cue.

edits.before: You keep winning through level 5, but the clock is against you. At 6 she gains ranged autos and Divine Judgment: the ult is pure invulnerability, so you cannot burst her during it, but she cannot kill you either, so keep pressuring on its cooldown. Try to force a kill or big CS lead before her first item lands. Every plate and every denied wave delays the inevitable.
edits.after: You keep winning through level 5, but the clock is against you. At 6 she gains ranged autos and Divine Judgment — pure invulnerability on a 160s cooldown at rank 1, so bait it and the next stretch of lane is free. She cannot kill you through it either. Force a kill or a big CS lead before her first item lands; every denied wave delays the inevitable.

edits.before: Kayle is a melee, rangeless punching bag pre-6: walk her down, stack Silver Bolts and deny CS to starve her scaling.
edits.after: Kayle is melee and rangeless pre-6: walk her down, stack Silver Bolts, and time the commit while her 15s W heal is down.

edits.before: Kayle's ult (Divine Judgment) gives invulnerability but no offense; you still dominate lane, just cannot burst her through it.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is invulnerability, not offense, and costs her 160s at rank 1 — bait it and the rest of the lane phase is yours.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — invulnerability at 900 range, 160s at rank 1 falling to 80s at rank 3. Bait it and the window is yours. - Celestial Blessing: 15s heal. - Condemn: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Invulnerability at 6, 160s at rank 1. Bait it, then the window is yours.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — W-shred + kite her.
edits.after: Track Divine Judgment: invulnerability, 160s at rank 1. Starfire Spellblade (E) is her auto reset.
